# use godownloader binary

Install `godownloader` as a prebuilt binary from the author's Homebrew tap ([kamilsk/homebrew-tap, `Formula/godownloader.rb`](https://github.com/kamilsk/homebrew-tap/blob/master/Formula/godownloader.rb)) instead of building it in the Go toolset — the counterpart of [[DOT-191]], keeping the tool without its dependency tree in `go.mod`.
